''1ˢᵗ – 2ⁿᵈ'' - BelowNatural |difficulty = Easy |length_measurement = 00:48.67 |wave_structure = Normal |rewards = {{RewardsList|Easy|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Grass Isle''' is a grassy island [[Maps|map]]. It has been remade multiple times since its addition to the game. ==Design & Path== {{Tabber |Current |'''Grass Isle''' is a small grassy island in the middle of the ocean. The terrain of this island is mountainous, though there are flat grassy plains on the island. Various rocks and trees can be found on the island. A bridge crosses over a water source. The brown path begins and ends at two caves at both ends of the island. The path crosses a wooden bridge across the water. |Version 3 |The third version of '''Grass Isle''' was a large island in the middle of the ocean. Despite this, a river flows through the middle of the island, with the source being an artificial pipeline at the top of a waterfall. When the river reached the sea, it was split in two by a small grass island. The terrain of the island was mountainous, though there were flat grassy plains on the island. Various rocks and trees could be found on the island. Some sand could also be seen and a smaller rock island could be seen in the middle of the ocean. The brown stone path began and ended at two caves at both ends of the island. The path crossed a cobblestone bridge over the river. |Version 2 |The second version of '''Grass Isle''' is identical to the current version, except terrain water surrounded the map, instead of baseplate water. |Version 1 |The first version of '''Grass Isle''' took place on a low lying grassy island in the middle of the ocean. There were few objects of note. There were three smaller chunks of rocks lower than the main terrain. Four trees and a grass mound could be seen. Some broken bits of rock by the caves could also be seen. The black slate path began and ended at two caves. The path cutback on itself many times as well as taking some long straights. }} ==Interactive Map== {{Map:Grass Isle}} ==Rewards== The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. {{Rewards|Easy|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} ==Strategy== *Most ground towers are suited for this map, due to the path's nature on cutting back on itself quite a few times. **However, be aware of the limited space available for towers. **Later on during the game, sell unnecessary towers to make space for essential ones. *If you need to bring [[Ranger]]s, make sure to sell any [[Sniper]]s that may occupy the mound and cliff to make space for [[Ranger]]s. *The [[DJ Booth]] can massively benefit towers, as the map itself is quite small. **A long-range tower, like the [[Ranger]], will be able to reach the entire map with a well placed [[DJ Booth]]. *As the map is quite short, you may want to use the [[Electroshocker]], [[Sledger]] or [[Toxic Gunner]] to slow down enemies. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Map Icons}} GrassIsle.png|First and second versions (13 October 2019 – 8 May 2021) GI logo.png|Third version (8 May 2021 – 12 March 2022) {{GalleryHeader|View}} GIView.png|First version (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) GIV2.png|Second version (29 October 2020 – 8 May 2021) GrassIsleView.png|Third version (8 May 2021 – 12 March 2022) {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} October10Icon.png|Current version on the game icon. ApriliniFoolsiniPI.png|Current version on a development image. }} ==Trivia== *This first version of the map was once used as the example for the Tower Defense Simulator Map Making Kit. *'''Grass Isle''' is used as the default background for player profiles, though an outdated version of it is used. *On the third version of the map, there is a humanoid figure wielding a scythe. **This humanoid has a similar skin tone and clothing as the [[Slasher]]. *On 7th of March 2022, this alongside [[Wrecked Battlefield]], [[Crystal Cave]] and [[Sacred Mountains]] were accidentally left as the only survival maps in the game. It alongside [[Crystal Cave]] were the only playable survival maps. **This was later fixed on the same day. ==Update History== *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **'''Grass Isle''' added. *'''4 March 2020''' - [[Release v1.8|Release v1.8.0]] **No longer playable on [[Versus]] mode. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **{{Color|Easy}} difficulty added. **Baseplate water replaced with terrain water. **No longer gives a badge upon first triumph. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Grass Isle''' remade. *'''12 March 2022''' - [[v1.1.0]] **'''Grass Isle''' remade. {{MapNavBox}}
